task.ques: Find a hotel in Barcelona for a stay from February 25-28, 2027. Please sort the results by distance from the beach and make sure they offer free Wi-Fi and breakfast.

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: Eurohotel Diagonal Port in Barcelona — February 25–28, 2027 (3 nights; 2 adults, 1 room).

It is the first result after sorting by “Distance from closest beach” with “Hotels”, “Free Wifi”, and “Breakfast included” applied. The listing is marked “Beachfront”; the Standard Double or Twin Room includes breakfast and free cancellation.

Displayed price: RSD 62,741 plus RSD 6,514 in taxes and fees for the stay.

Source: https://www.booking.com/searchresults.html?ss=Barcelona&dest_id=-372490&dest_type=city&checkin=2027-02-25&checkout=2027-02-28&group_adults=2&no_rooms=1&group_children=0&nflt=ht_id%3D204%3Bmealplan%3D1%3Bhotelfacility%3D107&order=closest_beach_distance_v2
Hotel: https://www.booking.com/hotel/es/rafaeldiagonal.html?checkin=2027-02-25&checkout=2027-02-28&group_adults=2&no_rooms=1&group_children=0
Evidence: final.png shows the selected dates, all three applied filters, beach-distance sort, and the hotel's beachfront and breakfast details together.
